method: Registered raster alpha >70; connected component at mouth; Zhang-Suen centerline; connected graph; longest upstream path for display hierarchy; Gaussian sigma 1 pixel; RDP tolerance 0.65 pixel; endpoint coordinates preserved.
limitations: Approximate centerline trace, not original Photoshop vector geometry.
Ranks are illustrative cartographic choices, not surveyed hydrological importance.
Only detail already present in the river layer is recovered.
Canonical river names are not assigned.
Other river systems and the separate lakes layer are outside this extraction.
